messages.content: Classify a prospect's email reply for a B2B sales outreach gate. Respond with ONLY a raw JSON object and nothing else — no markdown code fences, no commentary, no explanation. Exact shape: {"sentiment":"positive|neutral|negative","out_of_office":true|false}. positive = wants to talk, learn more, or is clearly interested. negative = declining, unsubscribe, or hostile. neutral = anything else (questions, confusion, unclear intent). out_of_office = true for ANY auto-reply/vacation/OOO message regardless of apparent sentiment.

parameters.subject: Positive reply — you take the follow-up

nodes.name: Propose Call to Human (Slack)
nodes.notes:
Reaching here means: positive reply, not out-of-office, real lead. Sends Approve/Decline to #marketing_testing_1 and waits.

⚠️ THE RENDERED MESSAGE IS `parameters.message`, NOT `parameters.text`. This is the `sendAndWait` operation, which reads `message`. A `text` key on this operation is INERT — n8n accepts it, stores it, shows no error, and ignores it. Cost 2026-08-17: the copy was 'updated' by writing to `text`, imported, published and restarted three times, and Slack kept posting the old wording. Verify a copy change by reading back `parameters.message` from workflow_entity, not by trusting the import.

Thoughtly (automated warm voice) was SKIPPED 2026-08-17 at the user's direction. There is no call node here and never was. The terminal action is a HUMAN follow-up, so the buttons mean 'I've got this' / 'not a lead' — not 'pre-approve a robot call'.

With no automated outbound voice anywhere in the pipeline, TCPA exposure is structurally zero rather than merely gated. If voice is ever revived, re-run the compliance gate BEFORE adding any dial node — the surviving TCPA gate is a leftover guard, not prior approval.

nodes.name: Read Leads (reply lookup)
nodes.notes:
Reads the whole Leads tab so the update can match on lead_id and FALL BACK to contact_email when the event carries no lead_id (or one that isn't on the tab). Without this read the fallback could not exist: a Sheets update whose match value hits no row simply does nothing, silently.

executeOnce + alwaysOutputData: one read per run, and a tab holding only its header row emits one empty {} placeholder instead of zero items, which would stall the branch.

nodes.name: Update Lead Row (by lead_id)
nodes.notes:
Header-name matching only (autoMapInputData + matchingColumns). The live Leads tab's column ORDER does not match SHEET_SCHEMA.md — lead_id is column P — so no node or script may address this tab by A1 letters.

`options.handlingExtraData: ignoreIt` is set for consistency with the append nodes, but do NOT rely on it here: the real guarantee is that the shape node in front emits real column names only. (An inert parameter on the wrong operation is a known trap on this instance — see the Slack node's note.)

nodes.name: Append Suppression Row (Suppression)
nodes.notes: APPEND ONLY — this is the one tab that must never be updated or deleted from. An opt-out or bounce recorded here is what stops the lead being contacted again on ANOTHER channel: VIO-intake-verify-curate matches this tab on every identifier before it spends a credit.
